📋 任务步骤
📋 Quest Steps
游戏开始，与泽尔达公主一同前往海拉鲁城堡地底调查红色淤泥异变。
The game begins: head with Princess Zelda to beneath Hyrule Castle to investigate the red gloom anomaly.
在地底深处发现被封印千年的加侬多夫干尸，封印突然崩解，链克右臂被侵蚀。
Deep below, discover the desiccated corpse of Ganondorf, sealed for a thousand years. The seal suddenly breaks apart, and Link's right arm is corrupted.
大地震发生，链克与泽尔达被弹飞——链克单独落在大天空岛上醒来，右臂已被一只古代神手取代。
A great earthquake strikes, and Link and Zelda are thrown apart — Link wakes alone on the Great Sky Island, his right arm replaced by an ancient arm.
在岛上遇到拉乌鲁的残影，他说明神手的能力需要先激活三个神庙来恢复。
On the island, meet the lingering spirit of Rauru, who explains that the arm's abilities must be restored by activating three shrines first.
完成乌科乌神庙（究极手）→ 茵加尔神庙（余料建造）→ 格班神庙（通天术）。
Complete the Ukouh Shrine (Ultrahand) → the In-isa Shrine (Fuse) → the Gutanbac Shrine (Ascend).
途中顺路激活各处视野点，善用「余料建造」制作木筏或飞行器跨越大裂缝。
Along the way, activate the viewpoints you pass, and make good use of Fuse to build rafts or flying machines to cross the great chasms.
进入「时间庭园」，解开需要倒转乾坤的谜题，从拉乌鲁手中获得完整的神手能力。
Enter the Temple of Time, solve the puzzle requiring Recall, and receive the complete arm abilities from Rauru.
学会倒转乾坤后，将庭园中央的巨石发射升空，链克踩上岩石飞出天空岛，向下跳落。
After learning Recall, launch the great stone at the center of the temple skyward, ride the rock off the Sky Island, and leap down.
💡 实用技巧
💡 Useful Tips
大天空岛资源有限，不要浪费武器在弱小敌人身上，优先用棍棒和石块。
Resources are limited on the Great Sky Island, so do not waste weapons on weak enemies; prioritize sticks and stones.
「余料建造」制作的「木板+木桩」可快速建造简易桥梁。
Fuse can quickly build a simple bridge from a plank + a stake.
时间庭园谜题：先用余料建造把铁球固定到升降台，再用倒转乾坤反转轨道。
Temple of Time puzzle: first use Fuse to fix the iron ball to the lift platform, then use Recall to reverse its track.

从大天空岛跳下，利用滑翔伞降落到海拉鲁中央平原（坐标约 0, 0, 100 附近）。
Jump down from the Great Sky Island and use the paraglider to land on Hyrule's central plain (around coordinates 0, 0, 100).
在平原上遇到士兵，跟随指引向北抵达监视堡垒（Lookout Landing）。
Meet soldiers on the plain and follow their directions north to Lookout Landing.
与军事顾问普尔鲁对话，她在瞭望塔顶层等待，爬上塔顶与她汇合。
Speak with military advisor Purah, who waits at the top of the lookout tower; climb to the top to meet her.
使用塔顶的望远镜观察远方浮空的海拉鲁城堡，确认红色淤泥笼罩城堡。
Use the telescope at the top of the tower to observe the floating Hyrule Castle in the distance and confirm that red gloom shrouds the castle.
普尔鲁说明利特村、卓拉领地、鼓隆城、格鲁德各地均有异变，委托链克调查。
Purah explains that Rito Village, Zora's Domain, Goron City, and Gerudo Town are all suffering upheavals, and asks Link to investigate.
激活监视堡垒视野塔，解锁中央平原地图区域，拍摄鸟瞰照片。
Activate the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower to unlock the central plain map region, and take an aerial photograph.
在堡垒内与队长霍兹对话，完成「海拉鲁城堡危机」支线，解锁城堡调查权限。
Inside the base, speak with Captain Hoz to complete the 'Hyrule Castle Crisis' side quest and unlock permission to investigate the castle.
